newsitem.title: USA: Com/Tech, Advanced Voice say not charged.
newsitem.headline: Com/Tech, Advanced Voice say not charged.

text.p: Com/Tech Communication Technologies Inc and Advanced Voice Technologies Inc said Wednesday that they are not charged in the complaint issued by NASD Regulation Inc., charging Sterling Foster Inc with improprieties from Sterling's role as underwriter in several public offerings of stock, including the companies' initial public offerings.

Both companies said that neither it nor its directors or officers are charged with any wrongdoing, or has any other agency alleged any wrongdoing on the part of the company or its directors or officers.
Both said it has always been their policy to conduct itself in full compliance with all applicable securities rules and regulations, and it is confident that it has done so in this instance.
